para.text: : the metafile is supposed to give an exact copy of what is displayed in the screen. Nevertheless small discrepancies may occur of, apparently caused by rounding errors in internal calculations of the screen position. This seems specially the case for fonts. The screen presentation of the metafile shows fonts different from direct plotting. To make things even more complicated: the exact behaviour depends on the selected font sizes, some match perfectly while one size larger or smaller differs. This is notably the case with oblique text where the font is clearly larger than their straight counterpart.
